verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents scoped API keys with limited permissions, created via `vastai create api-key`, and its API-keys guide explicitly recommends least-privilege keys for automation and shared tooling (docs-5, docs-19, docs-24). It also ships an agent skill that drives the platform on a user's behalf (docs-4). Missing for 10: details of the permission model and its granularity (which scopes exist, per-resource limits, expiry or rotation), explicit guidance tying scoped keys to the agent skill, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
